items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
items.summary: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.

items.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? 'Almost certainly not,' says Dragonfly's Qureshi
items.summary: Dragonfly's Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.

items.title: Optimizely Hack Hijacked Ledger, BBC and 176 Other Sites to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses
items.summary: Malicious code served through the website testing platform replaced visitors' wallet addresses with the attacker's and skimmed cards.

items.title: Lighter reopens withdrawals after trader's API key leak, returns about $5 million in USDC
items.summary: Lighter reopened deposits and withdrawals and said it returned about $5 million in USDC to the affected trader.

items.title: Lighter's exploit raises uncomfortable questions for Hyperliquid's $5.7 billion market
items.summary: After Lighter described a key-driven pool drain, Hyperliquid's permissions point to account losses while a matching extraction remains unproven.

items.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.
